label: StockX
terms_note: StockX seller account; developer application reviewed (5–7 business days) → x-api-key; OAuth per seller (offline_access for refresh); listings are asks on existing catalogue items (no custom products); StockX authenticates goods (ship to StockX); seller fees per level; rate limits documented (numbers not read); sandbox exists.

discovery.auth: oauth2 authorization-code via accounts.stockx.com (audience gateway.stockx.com, scopes offline_access openid; access 12 h + refresh) plus an `x-api-key` issued after developer approval (5–7 business days)

rate_limits: 1 request per second and 25,000 requests per day per API key (API Introduction); access tokens last 12 hours

auth: 1. Platform: StockX account → developer signup → approval (5–7 business days) → x-api-key → create an application (client id/secret, redirect).
2. Tenant authorises via authorization-code with scopes `offline_access openid` → access token (12 h) + refresh token.
3. Every call carries both the bearer JWT and x-api-key.

endpoints.purpose: find the catalogue product + size variant
create an ask (variantId, amount, currency, expiresAt)

reference.limits: Rate limiting applies (portal); numbers not read. - Developer approval + seller account; StockX API terms. - Goods ship to StockX for verification; asks only on catalogued products.
mcp_sdk: none official found in the pages opened

fields.name: api_key
fields.help: StockX API key from the Developer Portal Keys page (issued after developer access approval), sent as x-api-key on every call.

fields.name: client_id
fields.help: Client ID of your StockX application (Developer Portal > Applications; one application per StockX account).

fields.name: client_secret
fields.help: Client Secret of the same application.

fields.name: refresh_token
fields.help: Refresh token from a one-time Authorization Code consent (https://accounts.stockx.com/authorize with scope 'offline_access openid' and audience gateway.stockx.com, then POST /oauth/token grant_type=authorization_code). The runtime exchanges it for 12-hour access tokens (grant_type=refresh_token, audience=gateway.stockx.com).

config_fields.name: currency
config_fields.help: Currency code of your asks (AUD, CAD, CHF, EUR, GBP, HKD, JPY, KRW, MXN, NZD, SGD, USD); StockX defaults to USD when omitted.

adapter.terms: StockX Public API v2 (seller listings = asks, orders). Developer access requires StockX approval; 1 request/second and 25,000/day. Listing writes are asynchronous operations: poll GET /selling/listings/{listingId}/operations/{operationId}.

me.note: There is no account endpoint; the probe reads one listing (GET /selling/listings?pageSize=1) with the minted token and x-api-key.

update_listing.note: PATCH /selling/listings/{listingId} {amount (string), currencyCode} changes the ask price. Asynchronous: returns {listingId, operationId, operationStatus}. `title`, `description` and `quantity` are ignored (a listing is one ask on a catalogue variant).

end_listing.note: PUT /selling/listings/{listingId}/deactivate removes the ask from the marketplace (asynchronous operation; the listing can be re-activated with PUT …/activate).

list_orders.note: GET /selling/orders/active?pageNumber&pageSize(≤100)&orderStatus: orders from creation until payout. status: CREATED, CCAUTHORIZATIONFAILED, SHIPPED, RECEIVED, AUTHENTICATING, AUTHENTICATED, PAYOUTPENDING, PAYOUTCOMPLETED, SYSTEMFULFILLED, PAYOUTFAILED, SUSPENDED, PENDING, DONOTSHIP. `since` is ignored (only the historical-orders endpoint filters by date). amount is a string; product, variant and payout are in raw.

not_offered.create_listing: POST /selling/listings requires a StockX catalogue variantId (UUID) plus amount ('required': ['amount', 'variantId'], https://developer.stockx.com/portal/api-reference#tag/Listings/operation/Create); the vocabulary's title/sku cannot identify a variant.
not_offered.set_inventory: A StockX listing is a single ask for one unit of a variant; there is no quantity or stock field on CreateListingInput/UpdateListingInput (https://developer.stockx.com/portal/api-reference#tag/Listings).
not_offered.mark_shipped: Sellers ship with StockX-generated shipping documents (GET /selling/orders/{orderNumber}/shipping-document); the API has no call to submit a carrier or tracking number (https://developer.stockx.com/portal/api-reference#tag/Order).

evidence: host api.stockx.com: DNS ok, TLSv1.3 (Google Trust Services)
probe: 4/4 tools answered on their documented path with an auth refusal, a validation error or data; control route answered 403 too, so the host authenticates before routing
HTML docs spot-check (render-doc): 4/4 tool paths found verbatim on their docs pages; every parameter and body key named on the page
